cohort: The study included 64 preschoolers from resource-limited rural areas of Central China, comprising 32 suspected developmental delay children (DQ scores < 85) and 32 controls (DQ scores >= 85).
finding: Preschoolers from a former impoverished county exhibited epigenome-wide DNA methylation changes, including 66 differentially methylated regions and 844 methylated CpG sites, which were strongly linked to early neurodevelopment and global DQ scores.
